title: devbin macos publish, app-build and app-verify drop a second argument without a word
body:
`bin/devbin macos publish`, `app-build` and `app-verify` read only `${1:-}`, so a second argument is dropped without a word. That contradicts the rule `bin/.devbin/cmd/macos` states near its dispatch (issue 0395: an argument a subcommand cannot take is refused by name) and the subject of b8e3c3db9. None of the three is a signing run, so the harm is small.

Fix: refuse any argument beyond the one each takes. XS. Found in dc's doc sweep of 2026-09-18.


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train C on vc's word (bank d261b75a4, patch-id 86abd009a2b5, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainC/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
